method: 40 sequential spawns of the real helper with a UserPromptSubmit-shaped payload into a local accepting unix socket; first 5 discarded; CPU from RUSAGE_CHILDREN deltas, wall from perf_counter around spawn+exit
interpretation: A normal Claude turn fires two Loom hooks (UserPromptSubmit, Stop): about 8 ms CPU and 12 ms wall per turn, transient 6.5 MiB. No tool-level hooks are registered. A smaller helper would save a few milliseconds per turn; not worth a new component.
limits: Measured while two SwiftPM builds were running; wall time is an upper-biased estimate, CPU time is less affected.
Excludes Claude's own hook dispatch cost and Loom's receive-side processing.
Synthetic payload; real payload sizes are similar order (small JSON).
